offers_products.reason: Sells self-service programmatic advertising platform (software/SaaS) plus identity tools like UID2 to advertisers and agencies.

offers_services.reason: Main offering is the software platform; managed service is minor and not the core offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are advertisers, brands and agencies; consumers only see ads and do not purchase.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers, brands and agencies such as Disney+, Spotify, General Mills and OMD buy the platform.

recurring_revenue.reason: Advertisers and agencies continuously run campaigns on the platform, with ongoing spend-based fees and repeat usage.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising budgets are easily cut or postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Ad spend is continuous campaign-based buying in small increments, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the technology platform and data tools, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large agency holding companies and big brands like Disney+, General Mills, Suzuki.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and ad-tech platform; growth relies on engineering and cloud/data infrastructure rather than plants or fleets.
